title: Commands start, attach to, list and stop the server
body:
## Proposal

decade gets commands to start the server, attach a viewer, list what is running, and stop the server, and a fixed place for the server's socket and saved state. The exact command line is part of this issue's design. It changes the command line, so it goes on the sessions branch.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/6b9cbed5
notes.text:
`decade start`, `stop`, `restart` and `status` landed in ce0862d. The server writes its pid into `server.lock`, and `control::running` trusts that pid only while the lock is held. Attach and list are still open here.

`running` takes a shared lock for a moment when the lock is free. A server starting at that instant would see the lock held and exit with status 3. This has not been seen.
